error_categories.description: The trace relies on unsupported direct media claims about repeated metallic bangs at specific times and visual observation of severe ship roll/tilt, but provides no tool-attributed or text-grounded evidence for these audio/visual observations. In text-only mode, these are ungrounded premises.

Even if repeated bangs occurred, the trace does not justify why those sounds imply ship tilting rather than the other options. It does not compare the alternatives or explain the causal link from the reported background sound to the selected inference.

summary: The trace reaches a clear final answer, but in text-only verification its key premises are unsupported direct media claims. It also does not adequately connect the repeated background sound to 'ship tilting' over the other answer choices.
